statements.was: In 2026, we expect our capital plan to be approximately $3.3 billion.

statements.t: We plan to continue to make investments to support our growth strategy, improve the safety, resiliency, and operational efficiency of the network, harden our infrastructure, and replace older assets, including modernization of our locomotive fleet and acquiring freight cars to support replacement and growth opportunities.

This includes terminal investments supporting our manifest network and intermodal ramps to efficiently handle new and existing customers, along with siding investments (extensions and new), and second mainline track projects.
We have been, and we expect to continue to be, in compliance with our debt covenants.
